title: Roger Tinsley et al vs. Southeast Alabama Presbytery
disposition_detail: The complaint was found out of order because it was not timely filed within BCO 43-3's 30-day limit following the lower court's meeting. No merits ruling or other relief. Roll call: 14 concur, 0 dissent, 0 abstain, 9 absent, 1 recused.
first_summary: The SJC found the complaint of Roger Tinsley et al against Southeast Alabama Presbytery out of order because it was not timely filed under BCO 43-3, which requires filing within 30 days after the lower court's meeting.
